recognize_zh: 未染色的毛髮光學顯微鏡下，毛幹中央（髓質）可見大型、不規則且分布不均的黑褐色黑色素團塊，而非正常細小均勻的色素顆粒，是 Griscelli 症候群的典型毛髮表現。
features: Hair shafts examined by light microscopy, unstained
Large, irregular dark brown-black melanin clumps aligned mainly along the central (medullary) axis
Uneven, discontinuous distribution of pigment aggregates along the shaft (arrows)
Remaining cortex shows relatively sparse, fine pigment
No structural shaft abnormality such as twisting or nodes identified
describe_en: Light microscopic examination of unstained hair shafts shows large, irregular aggregates of melanin pigment clustered unevenly along the central axis of the shaft, with intervening areas of relatively pale cortex. The pigment clumps are considerably larger than the fine, evenly dispersed granules of normal hair, and no shaft structural defects are seen. These findings are consistent with the pigmentary hair abnormality of Griscelli syndrome; genetic testing (RAB27A, MYO5A, MLPH) and evaluation for hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis are recommended.

ddx.vs: Chediak-Higashi hair shows small, regularly spaced pigment granules, and blood leukocytes contain giant granules, which are absent in Griscelli syndrome.
Elejalde syndrome shows similar large irregular melanin clumps but is dominated by severe neurologic dysfunction without HLH; genetic overlap with Griscelli type 1 is debated.
Normal hair contains fine melanin granules distributed evenly throughout the cortex without large medullary clumps.
Albinism shows reduced or absent pigment without large clumped aggregates.
